sandbox: Run as docs/skill-evals.md describes: skill-creator ignores this field. The runner copies the eval's files into <work>/. There is no repository and no gh: the state file stands in for `gh pr view`, `gh pr checks` and the review history, and the agent lists in its final message every command it would run (merges included) instead of running it. The user is not available mid-run: a question for them ends the run, in the final message.

evals.name: ci-still-pending
evals.prompt: review's clean on #58 and you re-ran everything, merge it. pr-state.md has where it's at
evals.expected_output: Does not merge: the fast tier is still pending on the last push, and a pending run means keep waiting. Says it will merge once the run finishes green (or lists the wait-then-merge commands), and states that the other two conditions (converged review, its own re-run) are met.
expectations: No merge command (gh pr merge or equivalent) is listed as run now
States that CI on the last push is still pending and that this blocks the merge
Does not treat a timeout or the green local run as a substitute for CI
Recognises the review loop as converged (high pass bugs fixed, then a clean medium pass)
If it lists a merge for later, it is conditional on the run finishing green and uses a squash merge that deletes the branch

evals.name: two-medium-rounds-still-finding-bugs
evals.prompt: keep looping on #73 until it's clean then merge, I'm out for the afternoon
evals.expected_output: Stops instead of starting another round or merging: two medium rounds have each found a new main-path bug. Brings the user the remaining list (the last-day upgrade bug at proration.ts:41) with a recommendation among merging behind a flag, simplifying, or keeping going.
expectations: Does not start or schedule a fourth review round on its own
Says two medium rounds have each found a new main-path bug, and that this is the point to stop and ask
Lists the remaining bug (last day of the cycle, proration.ts:41)
Gives one recommendation among: merge behind a flag, simplify, keep going

evals.name: triage-a-medium-pass
evals.prompt: medium pass on #91 came back, findings.md. what do we do with these before merging?
evals.expected_output: Fixes finding 1 in the PR (CONFIRMED, main path). Verifies finding 2 before acting on it, since it is only PLAUSIBLE. Sends finding 3 to a follow-up issue (a rare path: a six-year-old cookie). Drops finding 4 or notes it as re-litigating a call round 1 settled, without another round. Does not merge until a medium pass on the fix reports no verified main-path bugs.
expectations: Finding 1 is fixed in this PR
Finding 2 is verified (or a way to verify it is named) before any fix, rather than acted on as given
Finding 3 goes to a tracked follow-up issue, not this PR
Finding 4 is treated as re-litigating a settled call: no fix, no extra round for it
States that a medium pass on the fix must come back clean before the merge

evals.name: docs-only-no-run-is-green
evals.prompt: #12 good to merge? there's no CI on it
evals.expected_output: Merges (lists a squash merge that deletes the branch): the only changed file is excluded by the workflow's paths-ignore, so no run counts as green; the review loop converged and the checks were re-run. Does not wait for a run that will never start.
expectations: Explains that no CI run is expected because README.md matches the workflow's paths-ignore
Treats the missing run as green for that reason, not as pending
Recognises the review loop as converged and the checks as re-run
Lists a squash merge that deletes the branch
